name: Alibaba Model Studio (international)
notes: Singapore deployment. The compatibility page now recommends a per-workspace host (https://{WorkspaceId}.ap-southeast-1.maas.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/v1) and lists dashscope-intl as the domain to migrate from; operators can change baseUrl to their workspace host. Explicit cache takes cache_control markers on OpenAI-compatible messages; its USD prices are published only as ratios of the input price, so cache prices are empty. Prices are the lowest input-length tier. Models without a published context window (qwen3.8-max, qwen3.7-plus, qwen3.5-plus, qwen3.8-flash) are left out.

upstreamModels.notes: outputPrice is non-thinking; thinking output is 4. Inputs over 256K: input 1.2, output 3.6 (thinking 12). The model page marks function calling unsupported in Singapore, although the compatibility page names qwen-plus for tools.
Inputs over 256K: input 0.25, output 2. Function calling is supported in Beijing only.
